response.sql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         CASE type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END AS signed_amount,
         balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE amount > 2400
),
per_acc AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_signed,
         AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM q
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS avg_signed_amount,
       AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance_after
FROM per_acc;

assumptions.assumption: The request's `trans.account_id` refers to the `account_id` column of `trans`, and the amount filter is strict (amount > 2400) on the stored unsigned `trans.amount`.

Per-account averages are computed over qualifying rows only, and the balance average includes every transaction type among those rows; the signed average uses only 'PRIJEM' and 'VYDAJ' rows, with NULL signed values (other types) skipped by AVG.

The final figures are unweighted means of the per-account averages across accounts that have at least one qualifying transaction, with accounts lacking any PRIJEM/VYDAJ row excluded from the first figure only (via NULL skipping in AVG).
